title: Puzzle: Molecular substances - 123 school
heading: Puzzle: Molecular substances
intro: Solve the clues and fill in the letters for each word. The boxes contain small numbers: the same numbers stand for the same letters, so a letter you already know can be used elsewhere. Then put the letters of the yellow boxes in the Solution table: together they form the key word. Click ‘Check answers’. Only the words that are completely filled in and the letters you entered in the Solution are checked.
